pairs.subject: concurrency-guards
pairs.evidence: src/components/primitives/TerminalPanel.tsx:3 The context is a set of stateless presentational components (props in, JSX out) with no async operations, effects, shared mutable state, file writes or keyed work; a grep of all 12 files for lock/mutex/inflight/pending/async/await/fetch/promise/setTimeout/idempot/dedup/useEffect/AbortController/localStorage/writeFile/rename found nothing, and mutex/singleFlight/acquireLock/fencingToken/tryBegin have zero hits anywhere under src/components, so no operation exists here that could run twice concurrently.
